title: Muse: a personal agent behind Privilege

glossary.definition: Whether a persona may call a tool at all. The first gate after detection.
The business rule inside an allowed call, such as a payment limit or an export row cap.
A detection flow in front of the gateway. It flags bursts of calls and instructions hidden in tool arguments. Simulated here.

sources.title: Personal Agent Pattern (owner diagram)
sources.use: Shape of the gateway: detect, coarse, fine.

cards.label: Trigger Muse-detect
cards.description: Send seven calls in a row and watch the seventh held.

cards.label: Staff cannot pay
cards.description: Sign in as staff and try a payment. The coarse check blocks it before any amount is checked.

cards.label: Big payments need a person
cards.description: A payment over 500 is held until approved (simulated CIBA).
